counterfactual_missing_items: raw evidence of metastasis or definite invasion
Ki-67 is only 2%, which is low for high-grade sarcoma
decisive_items: Positive for CD34, SMA, desmin, focal CD10, ER, PR, and 2% Ki-67; Negative for CD117, S-100, and Dog-1
10 cm mass was palpable in pelvic cavity
response.rationale: R4 is directly supported by biopsy and IHC raw spans: smooth muscle tumor with SMA/desmin positivity and CD117/S-100/Dog-1 negativity is consistent with leiomyosarcoma in this clinical/imaging context. C1 is a correlated anatomy-only restatement of the same diagnosis and lacks pathological evidence. R1 has no raw support and is contradicted by the smooth muscle tumor biopsy.

rejected.why: Same diagnosis as R4 but only adds pelvic location; lacks the decisive biopsy/IHC raw spans, so it is an incomplete correlated restatement.
No raw support spans; endometriosis is contradicted by biopsy showing smooth muscle tumor and by the IHC profile.
